about: The five attributes the player raises (GDD v2.2 section 6). Each starts at `base`; every level after the first gives `perLevel` points. `order` is the wheel, clockwise from the top: each job sits on one side of it, between two neighbouring attributes. At `jobLevel` the highest attribute and its higher neighbour pick the job; a tie goes to the job that suits how the player fights (`range`), then to the wheel's order. `secret`: every attribute within `spread` of the others, and the three-hands task done, gives the secret job instead. The system hints at the leaning attribute at `hintLevels`. effects: extra max health per VIT point and max energy per INT point above base, and skill power per point of the highest attribute above base.
